versions.changelog: Wallets already delegated to another EIP-7702 implementation can add redelegate:true to the direct lane: the sponsor returns an authorization you sign that re-points the wallet to Simple7702Account in the same transaction (reversible). Bring-your-own-operation remains for keeping your delegation.
ERC-7677 note: public bundlers only relay staked paymasters and this one is not staked yet; send the signed operation back to the same URL (bring-your-own-operation) and we submit it.

Bring-your-own-operation lane: any EntryPoint v0.8 smart account (already delegated elsewhere, or a deployed Kernel/Safe/Nexus account) can pay gas in USDC; no bundler, no paymaster stake. Reference client examples/gasless-bring-your-own.js.
Quote the homepage URL in front matter
First release: pay gas per op in USDC over x402 on Base; one endpoint for ERC-7677 SDKs and plain wallets (EIP-7702)
